reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Connecticut
    Focus year: 2021 (statute text provided is 2020; treated as controlling for 2021 question)
*/

/* =========================
   SCENARIO (Question Facts)
   ========================= */

% The question is a "statutory specification" question, not a dispute about a particular tenant.
scenario_state(connecticut).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_question(is_it_specified_for_which_cause_landlord_must_accept_tenant_attempt_to_cure).

% Helper predicate that "summarizes" the scenario facts.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(connecticut),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_question(is_it_specified_for_which_cause_landlord_must_accept_tenant_attempt_to_cure).

/* =========================
   STATUTE ENCODING
   CT Gen Stat  47a-15 (2020)
   ========================= */

% --- Causes (grounds/bases) that fall within the pretermination notice-and-cure framework
%     when the landlord chooses to evict based on such noncompliance.
%     (CT Gen Stat  47a-15 (2020))
statute_ct_47a_15_applicable_cause(material_noncompliance_47a11_affecting_health_safety_or_premises).
statute_ct_47a_15_applicable_cause(material_noncompliance_with_rental_agreement).
statute_ct_47a_15_applicable_cause(material_noncompliance_with_rules_adopted_under_47a_9).

% --- Explicit exceptions where 47a-15 is not the governing cure procedure because the
%     landlord elects to proceed under 47a-23 to 47a-23b to evict based on:
%     (CT Gen Stat  47a-15 (2020))
statute_ct_47a_15_excluded_cause(nonpayment_of_rent).
statute_ct_47a_15_excluded_cause(serious_nuisance).
statute_ct_47a_15_excluded_cause(violation_of_47a_11_h).

% --- What "serious nuisance" means (definition included for completeness).
%     (CT Gen Stat  47a-15 (2020))
statute_ct_47a_15_serious_nuisance_definition(inflicting_bodily_harm_or_threat_with_present_ability).
statute_ct_47a_15_serious_nuisance_definition(substantial_and_wilful_destruction).
statute_ct_47a_15_serious_nuisance_definition(immediate_and_serious_danger_to_safety).
statute_ct_47a_15_serious_nuisance_definition(prostitution_or_illegal_sale_of_drugs).

% --- Cure mechanics in 47a-15 are conditional: they apply when the breach is remediable by
%     (a) repairs by the tenant OR (b) payment of damages by the tenant to the landlord.
%     We model the *remedy modes* as statute-specified.
%     (CT Gen Stat  47a-15 (2020))
statute_ct_47a_15_remedy_mode(repair_by_tenant).
statute_ct_47a_15_remedy_mode(payment_of_damages).

% --- Core legal rule: if the breach is remediable by the above modes and is adequately
%     remedied within the 15-day period after notice, the rental agreement shall not terminate.
%     This is the "landlord must accept cure attempt (when adequate and timely)" concept.
%     (CT Gen Stat  47a-15 (2020))
%
% We express "must accept cure" as: for these causes, if (remediable + adequate cure within 15 days)
% then termination is barred (agreement shall not terminate).
statute_ct_47a_15_landlord_must_not_terminate_if_cured(Cause) :-
    statute_ct_47a_15_applicable_cause(Cause),
    \+ statute_ct_47a_15_excluded_cause(Cause).

% Timeliness threshold stated in the statute: "within such fifteen-day period".
% (CT Gen Stat  47a-15 (2020))
statute_ct_47a_15_cure_period_days(15).

/* =========================
   META-QUESTION REASONING
   "Is it specified for which cause a landlord must accept a tenant's attempt to cure?"
   ========================= */

% The statute "specifies causes" if it enumerates at least one included cause (for which cure can matter)
% and also delineates exclusions or conditions. This is a legal-interpretation helper:
% we treat the presence of enumerated applicable causes as specification.
statute_specifies_causes_for_cure_framework :-
    setof(Cause, statute_ct_47a_15_applicable_cause(Cause), Causes),
    Causes \= [],
    !.

% The statute specifies causes for which the landlord must accept/recognize cure (i.e., must not terminate
% if timely and adequate cure occurs) when it enumerates applicable causes for the 47a-15 framework.
statute_specifies_for_which_cause_landlord_must_accept_attempt_to_cure :-
    statute_specifies_causes_for_cure_framework,
    % Ensure at least one "must not terminate if cured" cause exists (ties specification to acceptance).
    setof(Cause2, statute_ct_47a_15_landlord_must_not_terminate_if_cured(Cause2), Causes2),
    Causes2 \= [],
    !.

/* =========================
   FINAL ANSWER
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    statute_specifies_for_which_cause_landlord_must_accept_attempt_to_cure,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* =========================
   MAIN / ENTRYPOINT
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it specified for which cause a landlord must accept a tenant's attempt to cure?
